paite: Chik lai peuh in leng TOUPA ka phat ding a; amah phatna ka kam ah apawt gige ding hi.
heading: Abimelek Ma A Kihaisak A, Ama'n Asawlkhiak A, Apaikhiak Lai A. David La / Pathian Hoihna Phatna
english: By David; when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed. I will bless Yahweh at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.

paite: Ka hinna in TOUPA asuang ding a, thunuailutte'n huai aza ding ua, akipak ding uhi.
english: My soul shall boast in Yahweh. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.

paite: Aw, TOUPA hon phatpih unla, amin pahtawi chiat ni.
english: Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let’s exalt his name together.

paite: TOUPA ka zong a ama'n ahon dawng a, ka kihtak peuhmah lak ah ahon humbit hi.
english: I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

paite: Amah a-en ua, huchi in ahong vakta uhi; amelte uh chik mah in azum kei ding.
english: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.

paite: Hiai migenthei akikou a, TOUPA'N aza a, amangbatna tengteng ah ahunkheta hi.
english: This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

paite: Amah laudan siamte tuh akimvel uah TOUPA angel in a-opkhum a, ahumbit hi.
english: Yahweh’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.

paite: Aw, TOUPA hoihdan chiam him dih ua; amah a muanna koihmi ahampha hi.
english: Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

paite: Amisiangthoute aw, TOUPA laudan siam un; amah laudan siamte a ding in taksapna himhim a-om louh ziak in.
english: Oh fear Yahweh, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.

paite: Humpinelkai lunlaite tuh atasam un agilkial naknak uh; TOUPA zongte zaw thil hoih himhim atasam kei ding uhi.
english: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.

paite: Kisa un, naupangte, ka thu ngaikhia un; TOUPA laudan ka hon hilh ding hi.
english: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.

paite: Hoihna amuhtheihna ding un, hinna deih a damsawt utmi kua ahia?
english: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?

paite: Na lei tuh gilou lak ah venghoih inla, na muk khemna thu gen lou ding in venghoih in.
english: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.

paite: Gilou paisan inla, thil hoih hih in; lemna zong inla, adelh in delh in.
english: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.

paite: TOUPA mit in midiktatte a-en gige a, abil in asap uh za ding in angaikhe gige hi.
english: Yahweh’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.

paite: TOUPA mel in thil hihkhialte adou a, amau theihgigena lei a kipan hihmangthang ding in.
english: Yahweh’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.

paite: Midiktatte akikou ua, TOUPA'N aza a, amangbatna tengteng uah ahunkheta hi.
english: The righteous cry, and Yahweh hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.

paite: TOUPA'N lungtang khasiate anaih zel a, lungsim a kisik peuhmahte ahondam zel hi.
english: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

paite: Midik haksatnate atam a, himahleh TOUPA'N huaite a pan ahonkhia ahi.
english: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.

paite: Aguh tengteng akemhoih a, khat lel leng hihtan ahi kei hi.
english: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.

paite: Thil hoih lou in migilou-saloute athat ding a; dik hote'n siam louh atang ding uhi.
english: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.

paite: TOUPA'N asikhate hinna atan a; amah a muanna koihte khat lel leng siam louh tang a-om kei ding uhi.
english: Yahweh redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.
